english_source_note: Lp Decay Rates Ensuring Almost Everywhere Convergence to 0
callout_id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#8
english_title: Example 2.4.2: The Typewriter Sequence Does Not Satisfy the Hypotheses of Proposition 2.4.1
statement_en:
Although the typewriter sequence converges to \(0\) in every \(L^p\) norm, it does not satisfy the variance condition in Proposition 2.4.1. Indeed, for every \(2^k \leq n < 2^{k+1}\),
\[
\mathrm{Var}(f_n)=E(f_n^2)-(E(f_n))^2=\frac{1}{2^k}-\frac{1}{4^k},
\]
so
\[
\mathrm{Var}(f_n) \geq \frac{1}{2^{k+1}} \geq \frac{1}{2n}.
\]
Hence \(\sum_{n\geq 1} \mathrm{Var}(f_n)\) diverges, so the typewriter sequence does not satisfy the variance hypothesis of Proposition 2.4.1.
callout_body: 我们已经知道对于打字机函数列而言$f_n$对任意的$L^p$范数都是收敛到0的。此处的关键在于计算这个函数列的方差。由于$$V(f_n)=E(f^2_n)-(E(f_n))^2=\frac{1}{2^k}-\frac{1}{4^k}$$对任意的$2^k\leq n<2^{k+1}$成立。那么由于$$V(f_n)\geq \frac{1}{2^{k+1}}\geq \frac{1}{2n}$$因此$\sum_{n\geq 1}V(f_n)$不是一个收敛的级数，因此打字机数列并不满足“命题2.4.1”对方差的要求。
